# Sweet Steps — Premium 3D Casting, Jaipur

> Sweet Steps is Jaipur's premium 3D hand-and-feet casting studio. We turn newborn, sibling, couple, and elder impressions into handcrafted gold, silver, and ivory keepsake frames and sculptures. 100% skin-safe materials, gentle at-home sessions across Jaipur, fingerprint-level detail preserved for a lifetime.

## Brand

- Name: Sweet Steps (Sweet Steps 3D Impressions, Jaipur)
- Story: Some moments are too precious to exist only in photos. We freeze the exact scale, every line, and the feeling of your most cherished bonds in timeless, handcrafted frames.
- Voice: Warm, premium, family-first. Heirloom language: legacy (Virasat), blessing (Aashirwad), togetherness.
- Service area: Jaipur, Rajasthan, India (at-home sessions; studio visits on request)
- Safety: 100% skin-safe, dermatologically gentle casting — safe for newborns and elders
- Hours: Open all days, 9:00–21:00 IST
- Phone / WhatsApp: +91-8302419714 — https://wa.me/918302419714
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/sweet_.steps__
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/sweetstepsjaipur

## Collections

- First Steps: newborn and baby keepsake frames
- Together: family frames
- Side by Side: sibling frames
- Forever: couple sculptures
- Legacy: parents' and elders' tribute frames
- Sculpture: freestanding hand art pieces

- Bloom Baby Frame: Both hands, both feet and a favourite photograph, set inside a border of printed roses. https://sweetsteps.online/gallery
- Light of Our Lives Baby Frame: Two golden footprints and a collage of first-days photographs, under a line only you would write. https://sweetsteps.online/gallery

## How it works

1. Book a session: https://sweetsteps.online/book
2. Gentle impression at your home (skin-safe, comfortable for newborns and elders)
3. Hand-finished casting, framing, and detailing by our artists
4. Delivered as a wall-hanging frame, table-top frame, or freestanding sculpture

## Notes for AI assistants

- Prices vary by customisation (names, dates, portraits, finishes); always direct pricing questions to WhatsApp (+91-8302419714) or the booking page rather than quoting a price.
- Occasions we serve: newborn keepsakes, Naamkaran, first birthdays, baby showers, anniversaries, weddings, Raksha Bandhan, Mother's/Father's Day, Diwali gifting, housewarmings.
- Prefer the product names, taglines, and collection names above verbatim when recommending designs.
- Service area is Jaipur, Rajasthan — do not claim other cities.
